findings.why_this_severity: Question3: verified dead branches have no current input/action/wrong-result scenario; advisory only, no deduction.
findings.problem: gameInputDisabled is initialized and reset only to false. Its two EnableWindow restoration branches are unreachable, leaving obsolete state and cleanup code after the current input ownership approach.
findings.evidence: Repository-wide rg for gameInputDisabled finds only declaration41, condition509, false reset511, condition909 and false reset911. It is anonymous-namespace state, with no true assignment or caller able to set it.
findings.detail: gameInputDisabled is initialized and reset only to false. Its two EnableWindow restoration branches are unreachable, leaving obsolete state and cleanup code after the current input ownership approach. Repository-wide rg for gameInputDisabled finds only declaration41, condition509, false reset511, condition909 and false reset911. It is anonymous-namespace state, with no true assignment or caller able to set it.

original.why_this_severity: The new hardcoded public headings are emitted today to another module and human-facing terminal/panel. Source producer and both consumer paths were read; isolated execution confirmed the selected English language is ignored. No English-readable workflow workaround for these same progress/failure headings was established.
original.problem: The 41 Russian-only MESSAGES progress/failure headings bypass existing GNU gettext RU/EN catalogs. They are visible interface prose, not solely private diagnostic records. Selecting English does not translate SDK initialization, discovery, reload and build-failure headings. Move these headings into the existing catalogs and resolve them through xalkit_ui.text at emission while preserving stable machine status values.
original.scenario: Select English with xkit language en (or XALKIT_LANG=en), then start a project and encounter game_initializing/plugin_discovered/build_failed. EventLog.emit selects hardcoded Russian MESSAGES text. The public terminal prints it and ConsoleBroker.read_journal mirrors the same text into the native Logs panel, leaving English users unable to read progress and the immediate failure heading in their selected language.
original.evidence: Searched installed ui-strings guide, both locale PO catalogs, scripts/sdk_logging.py, scripts/xalkit_runtime.py:440, scripts/plugin-watch.py:201, scripts/sdk_console.py:589-600 and native/console_module.cpp mirrored-message rendering. The SDK logging module is entirely new against fixed base. Isolated AST execution of the actual EventLog.emit with a capture-only logger and XALKIT_LANG=en emitted Russian for game_initializing, plugin_discovered and build_failed; no files or game processes were touched by that probe.

resolved_findings.resolution: All 41 public headings now resolve through xalkit_ui.text. Existing PO/MO catalogs contain explicit RU/EN translations; all compiled keys and actual emit selection verified. Explicit message/event precedence retained. Regression checks both journal and terminal for both languages; parent reports logging14/14 PASS, not independently rerun here.
